title: Games: friends panel, sign-in and lobby — round 2

steps.headline: The sign-in card now matches the Account popup's: a left-aligned line and a full-width filled Sign in.
steps.changed: Copied from Settings → Account's signed-out card (you picked full width in GC-2).
steps.notice: Same sentence, smaller and left-aligned like other cards; the button runs across the card.

steps.path: Gamepad button, signed in with four friends
steps.headline: Signed in, the friends card starts folded to one line, with your status as a dropdown on the right.
steps.changed: One line: "2 of 4 online" and an arrow; the Online / Incognito dropdown replaces the status pill and Go incognito button.
steps.notice: Click the line to open the list. The card folds again every time Games opens, so the games stay in view.

steps.path: Gamepad button, signed in, a request each way, card opened
steps.headline: Opened, the list scrolls inside a capped box with a filled Add a friend inside it, like Appearance's themes box; Accept is on the right.
steps.changed: The list stops at about five rows and scrolls under a fade. Add a friend is filled and sits inside the box. Accept is now right of Decline.
steps.notice: Add a friend opens the handle box in the button's place, with Cancel beside it.

steps.path: Gamepad button, twelve friends, card opened
steps.headline: With many friends, the list stays the same height and scrolls; online friends come first.
steps.changed: A new practice state with twelve friends, to show the capped, scrolling list.
steps.notice: The games stay right under the card instead of being pushed down.

steps.path: Gamepad button: incognito · no internet · game server down
steps.headline: Incognito, no internet and a broken game server now look different: different line, notice and greyed games.
steps.changed: Incognito: no notice, games still open. No internet: amber notice, Connect 4 and Chess greyed. Server down: red notice with Try again, same two greyed.
steps.notice: "No internet" appears only when the computer reports no network at all, never as a guess.

steps.headline: The server-down state against round 1: a red notice with Try again inside the card, and a shorter line.
steps.changed: Round 1 only changed your status pill to Offline. Now the line says "Game server unreachable" and a notice explains, with Try again.
steps.notice: Try again reconnects; Flappy and 2048 keep playing either way.

steps.headline: A game's page: each friend's record is a sentence under the name, the status pill beside the name, Challenge on the right.
steps.changed: The score column and "Your record" label are gone (you picked the sentence). Rows follow the sessions menu: pill after the name.

steps.headline: Connect 4's page with the same row arrangement at its narrower width.
On a phone the folded friends line and the dropdown fit the width, and the games are right below.
steps.changed: The card is folded here too.

steps.headline: A game's page on a phone with the new rows.
steps.notice: Long names shorten with dots; the pill stays beside the name.

steps.headline: In a small window the games are back in view, because the friends card starts folded.
steps.changed: Round 1 filled the first screen with friends.

steps.path: Gamepad button, signed in, no friends yet
steps.headline: With no friends yet the folded line says so; opening it shows the line and the filled Add a friend.
steps.changed: Was the always-open card with the handle box.
steps.notice: Connect 4 and Chess still say "No friends online" and open.

steps.path: Gamepad button, signed in with four friends
steps.headline: Which one-line summary should the folded friends card show?
steps.notice: Both keep the status dropdown on the right and open on click; problem states replace the line in both.

variants.label: Count
variants.summary: "2 of 4 online", plus "· 1 request" when one is waiting. Short; always fits.

variants.label: Names with a pill
variants.summary: A green "2 online" pill, then who: "Jake, Mira". Tells you who without opening.
variants.risk: Long names cut off with dots in a narrow pane.

steps.headline: How should a game's page lay out each friend?
steps.notice: Both show the record as a sentence under the name.

variants.label: Like the sessions menu
variants.summary: Plain rows in one card, the status pill right after the name, Challenge at the right edge.

variants.label: Like the Settings list
variants.summary: Each friend in its own box, 8px apart; the pill sits beside Challenge at the right.
